This is the fifth bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS,2023 filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.280/2023 dated 09.09.23 registered at Police Station Madan Mahal, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 450,376,376(3),506-II of IPC and section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 10.09.2023.

2. Applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide orders dated 0 1 . 0 2 . 2 0 2 4 , 1 2 . 0 4 . 2 0 2 4 , 3 0 . 0 4 . 2 0 2 4 a n d 2 2 . 0 7 . 2 0 2 4 p a s s e d i n M.Cr.C.Nos.2511/24,12712/24,11531/24 and 28255/24 respectively.
However, vide order dated 22.07.2024 this court had directed the State to produce the prosecutrix before the trial court within a period of two months from today for tendering her evidence.

3. As per the prosecution story, on 25.08.2023, the applicant who is school NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50798 2 MCRC-42896-2024 van driver, by riding motorcycle came to the house of prosecutrix, committed rape upon her and threatened to do death.
F.I.R was registered.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant is in jail for the last one year and in this period State has not produced the prosecutrix for tendering her evidence despite direction given by this court on 22.07.2024.
Prosecutrix is deliberately is not appearing before the court for tendering her evidence.
It is further contended that F.I.R has been lodged almost after 15 days of the incident and D.N.A report is negative.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. Applicant is in jail for last more than one year and despite this court's direction, State has failed to produce the prosecutrix before the trial court for tendering the evidence.
In absence of evidence of prosecutrix, accused cannot be kept behind the bar for an indefinite period.
Therefore, on the ground of delay in trial, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I deem it a fit case for grant of bail.

Consequently, this application is allowed subject to following conditions :-
(i) It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50798 3 MCRC-42896-2024 all the dates given by the concerned Court.
It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C/480(3) of BNSS,2023.
(ii) He shall not contact the prosecutrix and her family members while on bail and shall not make any attempt to influence the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) He shall not get himself indulge in any other offence in this period.
(iv) He shall not seek any adjournment whenever the witnesses are in attendance before the trial court.

(v) It is further made clear that in case if the applicant is found involved in any other offence during the pendency of the trial, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically and the concerned trial Court and police will be at liberty to commit him to jail.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Shubhan Choutel @ Shivam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142482908/
